atlasDraft.pZh: 潮退时，船底的干痕仍在。门槛上的盐少了一角，阿汐没有补齐。她把水壶放回原处，听见船板在潮气里轻轻收紧。船没有启程，门也没有关。天亮后，水壶旁多了一粒盐。她没有问它从哪里来。
atlasDraft.pEn: At ebb, the dry mark beneath the boat remained. One corner of the salt on the threshold was gone; Axi did not replace it. She put the water jar back and heard the boards tighten in the damp. The boat did not leave. The door stayed open. By morning, one grain of salt lay beside the jar. She did not ask where it came from.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 有些东西回来，不必经过门。
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some things return without crossing the door.
